messages:
Omar R.: did a fast pass on the handbook this morning, found 2 broken images and one outdated CLI example. leaving here so we can divvy up.
Mei L.: can you drop the paths? I have a free slot after lunch and can take the CLI example.
Omar R.: sure — /kb/handbook/deploy-checklist has image 403 (s3 staging key), /kb/runtime/throughput mentions `redwood-cli v0.9` which is old, and /kb/console/monitoring -> image link 404.
Carlos H.: i'll rehost the missing images to assets.redwood.cdn and update markdown. tagging @mei for the CLI bump.
docs-lint-bot: link-scan result at 2002129999: 2 external 404s, 1 asset 403. suggested labels: docs-bug, quickfix.
Mei L.: grabbing the CLI example now. will replace `redwood-cli v0.9` -> `redwood-cli v1.3` and add a note about `--region` default change. will open a small PR.
Omar R.: thanks — Carlos, can you add alt text while you're at it? small request from accessibility review.
Carlos H.: yep. plan: copy images into /canonical-assets/handbook/, update IMG src to the canonical path, add alt text lines. i'll make the PR and request a review from @docs-owners.
Mei L.: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/415 — sed patch + brief changelog entry. CI preview should show updated snippet.
Omar R.: sweet. one more thought: can we add a one-line smoke-check in each page's frontmatter for the asset fetch? like `preview_fetch: true` so CI tries to fetch and fails loudly? small change but would catch 403s earlier.
docs-lint-bot: feature-request logged at 2002130005: add preview asset validation to docs CI.
Carlos H.: good idea. i'll include a checklist item in my PR and file a follow-up ticket for the CI change.
Omar R.: awesome. if anyone else spots stale examples while editing, post path + repro here and we'll batch the tiny fixes. cc: @eng-docs :mag:
